rationale.provenance-auditability: Identifiers and persistent logs support attribution, audits, and incident forensics.
rationale.org-governance: Defines broad monitoring, logging, accountability, and stakeholder governance arrangements.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Real-time monitoring applies activity restrictions, permission limits, caps, and thresholds.
rationale.risk-routing: Computed flags and risk levels determine intervention and monitoring intensity.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Agent cards and logs expose goals, permissions, dependencies, and activities.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Monitoring detects violations of allowed activities, tools, permissions, and scope.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Agent cards record dependencies, developers, deployers, compute, and tool providers.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Measures support regulators, legal accountability, standards, GDPR, and audit evidence.
rationale.design-only: Specifies implementable visibility mechanisms without building or evaluating them.
rationale.general-ai: The governed objects are general-purpose AI agents, not coding systems.
rationale.agentic: Focuses on autonomous, long-horizon systems acting with limited supervision.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes unjustified dependence and societal disempowerment from autonomous agents.
